q: Peraturan CLASS 2013 diwartakan pada:
e: Citation: gazetted on 11 Oct 2013; take effect 12 Oct 2013; replacement of OSH (CPL) Regulations 1997.

q: Sistem antarabangsa yang diterima pakai ke dalam rangka undang-undang Malaysia melalui CLASS ialah:
e: Rationale: adoption of GHS into Malaysia legal framework; harmonization in line with UN resolution.

q: Penyelarasan keperluan klasifikasi, pelabelan dan SDS di bawah CLASS adalah selaras dengan resolusi:
e: Harmonization of Classification, Labelling and SDS requirements in line with UN resolution.

q: Objektif CLASS ialah memupuk penggunaan selamat bahan kimia berbahaya melalui:
e: Objectives: inculcate safe use of hazardous chemicals through hazard identification and communication; prescribe supplier duties.

q: Pengitar semula (recycler) bahan kimia dikategorikan sebagai:
e: Principal suppliers: manufacturer, formulator, importer, recycler and reformulator.

q: Tugas pembekal utama yang TIDAK menjadi tugas pembekal subsidiari ialah:
e: Principal suppliers: classification, packaging, labeling, SDS. Subsidiary suppliers (repacker, distributor, retailer): packaging, labeling, SDS.

q: Peruncit (retailer) bahan kimia dikategorikan sebagai:
e: Subsidiary suppliers: repacker, distributor and retailer.

q: Produk kosmetik di bawah Peraturan CLASS adalah:
e: Not applicable: radioactive material, scheduled waste, cosmetic products, R&D chemicals under 5kg, pesticides, chemicals stored prior to export.

q: Bahan kimia yang disimpan sebelum dieksport di bawah CLASS:
w: Memerlukan SDS dalam bahasa negara pengimport sahaja
e: Application – not applicable to chemical stored prior to export.

q: Klasifikasi berdasarkan bahaya fizikal, kesihatan dan alam sekitar dibuat mengikut:
e: Classification: based on classified chemicals in Part 1 of ICOP; based on physical, health and environmental hazards in Part 2 of ICOP.

q: Bahan pembungkusan bahan kimia di bawah CLASS mestilah:
c: Tidak bertindak balas dengan bahan kimia tersebut
e: Packaging: chemical cannot escape, strong, material not reacting with the chemical, sealed with unrepairable seal.

q: Pembungkusan bahan kimia mesti dimeterai dengan:
c: Meterai yang tidak boleh dibaiki (unrepairable seal)
w: Penutup yang boleh dibuka berulang kali
e: Packaging must be sealed with unrepairable seal.

q: Maklumat pada label yang mengenal pasti pembekal dipanggil:
e: Labelling: product identifier, supplier identification, signal word, hazard statement, hazard pictogram, precautionary statement.

q: Label bahan kimia di bawah CLASS perlu dilekatkan dengan kukuh dan:
e: Label shall be firmly affixed to one or more surface and can be read horizontally; if not practicable, tagging can be used.

q: Keperluan minimum kandungan SDS adalah mengikut:
e: SDS: 16 information, in accordance with minimum requirement in Part 3 of ICOP, in National language and English.

q: SDS perlu disemak semula apabila:
c: Terdapat maklumat baharu tentang bahan kimia berbahaya tersebut
e: SDS should be revised: new information on hazardous chemical, time elapsed after preparation/revision, or directed by an officer.

q: Pembekal bertanggungjawab untuk:
c: Membekalkan SDS yang dikemas kini kepada penerima
w: Hanya memberikan SDS apabila diminta mahkamah
e: SDS: duties of supplier to furnish updated SDS to the recipient.

q: Inventori bahan kimia di bawah CLASS mesti merangkumi nombor:
e: Inventory information: product identifier, name, composition & ingredients, hazard classification, total quantity supplied/imported, shall include CAS no.

q: Bagi kesalahan berterusan di bawah CLASS, denda tambahan ialah:
e: Penalty: fine not exceeding RM10,000 or 1 year imprisonment or both; continuing offence RM1000/day.

q: Garis panduan yang berkaitan dengan Peraturan pelabelan bahan kimia termasuk:
c: Garis Panduan Penyediaan Risalah Data Keselamatan Kimia
w: Garis Panduan Kerja di Tempat Tinggi
e: Guidelines: Classification of Hazardous Chemicals; Formulation of Chemical Safety Data Sheet; Labelling of Hazardous Chemicals.
